generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of Power station control room (发电站控制室). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Photograph a staffed power-station control room from behind one central operator desk, with a restrained documentary look. Span the upper wall with a graphical process display made only of simple coloured lines and shapes, without words or numbers. In the middle, distinguish the monitor bank, turbine console, analogue pressure gauge, key-switch panel and amber alarm beacon. Place the headset and dispatch microphone on opposite sides of the foreground desk, with the emergency shutdown button under a protective cover and the card reader beside the door. One operator may sit facing away, not touching controls. Use balanced cool screen glow and neutral room light. No crisis, flashing red room, readable data, nuclear symbolism, duplicate monitors presented as targets or science-fiction interfaces.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: turbine control console, graphical process display wall, analogue industrial pressure gauge, amber alarm beacon, control-room operator headset, dispatch desk microphone, industrial monitor bank, key-switch control panel, emergency shutdown push-button, control-room access-card reader.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
